identities.name: cyclotomic_complement
identities.role: forces the bridge after Phi3 normalization

identities.name: mixer_imbalance
identities.role: mixer layer input to the bridge operator

theorem_statement: The unique CL bridge token 10/13 is forced by the cyclotomic identity Phi4=Phi3-q. Since the mixer imbalance is D=q/Phi3, applying the complement operator B(D)=1-D gives Phi4/Phi3=P(Phi4). Thus the mixer/projection intersection is inevitable.
interpretive_note: This makes the two-layer algebra much tighter: the bridge is not an empirical overlap between two lists. It is the normalized cyclotomic complement of the q-imbalance. Phi4 is literally the part of Phi3 left after removing the q-clock.
